headline: Complete Bathroom Renovation Guide: Planning Your Layout and Finishes
articleBody:
A complete bathroom remodel refreshes your daily routine while adding functional value to your home. Here is a clear guide on how the process works from first concepts to final fixtures.

Overview and Key Benefits:
A full renovation goes beyond cosmetic swaps to update subfloors, supply lines, ventilation, and custom storage, creating an efficient and relaxing space.

Process Breakdown:
- Site Assessment & Layout: Reviewing current plumbing lines, taking precise room measurements, and deciding whether to keep or shift the footprint.
- Permitting & Product Selection: Finalizing vanities, tile, and plumbing trims early so all rough-in dimensions are set before inspections.
- Demolition & Rough-Ins: Opening walls, verifying framing, running new electrical wiring, and plumbing new valves.
- Waterproofing & Finishes: Installing certified moisture membranes, tiling custom showers, laying down durable flooring, and setting vanities.

What to Prepare Before You Start:
Take time to inventory your storage habits and confirm where your primary exhaust path exits the building. Having fixture specifications ready keeps the rough-in phase on schedule.
